name: Tacy Cummings
statement: Hey there, I'm Tacy Cummings, a mural artist based in Iowa. I'm all about color, texture, and making bold and vibrant statements through my art. My work is unique and reflects my passion for bringing communities together. I love creating large-scale pieces that really make an impact and add a pop of color to the everyday world. Whether it's a whimsical mural in a children's playground or a thought-provoking piece on a city street, I strive to engage and connect with the people around me. My art is a reflection of my love for both creativity and community.
